preprocessing.limitations: lexical filtering, not semantic understanding or POS tagging; unigrams lose context; inflected forms remain separate
preprocessing.phrase_display: prefer longer phrase when it covers at least 80% of occurrences of a contained shorter phrase; complete counts remain in phrases
preprocessing.phrase_policy: 2-3 consecutive tokens; punctuation, URLs, email and invalid tokens break adjacency; content endpoints or leading negation; internal function words retained
preprocessing.ranking: descending total occurrences, then document frequency, then alphabetical
preprocessing.scope: EDA only; frozen classifier preprocessing unchanged
preprocessing.unicode: HTML unescape then NFKC/casefold; curly apostrophe normalized
preprocessing.word_policy: whole ASCII alphabetic tokens, at least 3 letters; no stemming or dictionary-based correction
